text:
emma_cs: Heads-up: Lumenix flagged for a surprise embeddings surge ahead of their renewal. Need a short playbook and numbers for Wednesdays QBR.
rahul_se: Whats the spike shape? sustained or a one-off batch?
emma_cs: Appears recurring every 6 hours from a new ingestion job. Noticed uptick starting 9 days ago.
billing-bot: [auto] Account=Lumenix | 7d_tokens=1,940,120 | projected_30d=8,316,000 | contract_commit=3,000,000 | alert=projected_over_commit
lia_fin: If projection holds, theyre ~5.3M tokens over commit. Renewal risk if unmitigated. Need two scenarios for exec: quick wins and conservative ops.
maria_enablement: Ill prepare a one-page "embeddings cost playbook" aimed at their ML infra: caching strategies, request dedupe, reduced dimension embeddings, and run schedule gating.
devon_ops: From infra perspective: can we suggest rate limiting at the edge or moving non-critical jobs to off-peak windows?
rahul_se: Yes. Also propose a canary: swap to a quantized embedding model for 10% of traffic for 48h and monitor similarity metrics. If delta < 3%, we can increase.
emma_cs: Lia, can you run two cost sims: (A) 35% reduction from batching + caching, (B) 65% reduction from batching + quantized model + gating. Need token and $ estimates.
lia_fin: Running quick calc: projected 30d = 8,316,000 tokens. A -> 5,405,400 tokens (over commit by 2,405,400). B -> 2,910,600 tokens (within commit). Rough $ estimates coming.
maria_enablement: Drafting checklist with sample config snippets and a short email template we can send to Lumenix infra.
rahul_se: Sample monitoring triggers to include: embedding_request_rate > baseline * 2 for >1h, avg_similarity_drop > 3%, error_rate > 1%.
devon_ops: Edge throttle snippet weve used:
```
# nginx-lua pseudo-config
if embeddings_rate > 100rps then
  apply_rate_limit("low_priority", 10rps)
end
```

devon_ops: Also suggest a short-term quota: cap daily embeddings to X until they confirm changes.
emma_cs: Who can own the outreach? We need to book a 20-min troubleshooting call asap.
rahul_se: Ill message their infra lead + cc emma_cs. Setting meeting for Tue 11am.
lia_fin: Ill add the two-scenario slide and a short renewal-risk note. Send numbers by Mon EOD so I can polish for Wed.
maria_enablement: Uploaded initial playbook draft: https://drive.internal/r/enablement/lumenix-embed-playbook. Feedback welcome.
billing-bot: [auto] Created alert: account=Lumenix | alert_type=high_projection | channel=#customer-success | severity=warning
emma_cs: Timeline: Rahul outreach (owner), Maria playbook (owner), Jon? (tech snippets)  actually jon is OOO, devon will own infra snippets. Lia will finalize slides. Reconvene after the customer call.
devon_ops: Will add the gating config and sample cron changes to the doc.
lia_fin: Note for exec: if unmitigated, projected ARR impact = incremental overage * sample price. Ill include both token deltas and $ figures.
rahul_se: Invite sent.
emma_cs: Thanks team. Keep replies short here; Ill collate into the QBR deck once weve got customer confirmation. :thumbsup:
